_doc: Registry of FROZEN PREREG RIDERS and their firing status. A rider is a numeric or categorical threshold stated IN ADVANCE in a frozen prereg, whose crossing falsifies a NAMED chain. When one fires, every site printing that chain's OUTPUT VALUES is stale -- and no other checker in this repo can see that, because the board and the staleness scan both key on CITATIONS while supersession of this kind lives in VALUES. Authoring a row is a reading job, done once; verify-fired-riders.py then enforces it mechanically. Inventory source: research lane 2026-09-06, 17 riders swept, 5 FIRED.
_pattern_rule: output_patterns must be DISTINCTIVE. A bare short decimal ('1.08', '0.367') or a bare percent ('1.7%') matches half the corpus and is excluded by hand -- an over-broad pattern makes the checker cry wolf and get ignored, which is worse than no checker. When in doubt leave the pattern out and rely on the ledger check.
